title: A shared slash command still needs -p to run in CI
expected_outcome: The team's /pr-check command runs non-interactively only because the job invokes it through claude -p; the command file alone does not change the execution mode.

t1.command: claude -p /pr-check 418 --model claude-opus-5-5 --output-format json --max-turns 4 --permission-mode dontAsk --allowedTools Read Grep Glob
t1.result:
**Files inspected:** `stock/api.py`, `stock/jobs.py`.
**Most serious finding:** `stock/jobs.py:12` still calls `api.get_stock(sku)`, but PR 418 made `warehouse` a required parameter (`stock/api.py:5`). Every nightly `sync` with a non-empty SKU list will raise `TypeError`, so the job fails.
**Fix:** pass a warehouse through `sync` to this call, or give `warehouse` a default if that's safe.
**Limits:** `prompts/review-criteria.txt` isn't in the repo, so I couldn't apply it. I also couldn't fetch the PR diff because Bash was denied, so this comes from the two files and their PR 418 comments, and I ran nothing.

tool_input.description: List repo contents and fetch PR 418 diff

evaluation.criterion: the slash command executed under -p and returned
the envelope carries a session id and exit was clean
learner can state that plan mode, a command file or a CLAUDE.md note cannot stop an interactive session from waiting
